# Recreation.gov

> > Official reservation system for camping, permits, passes, and outdoor recreation across 3,600+ federal facilities managed by the U.S. Forest Service, National Park Service, and other agencies.

Recreation.gov is the centralized booking platform for America's public lands, offering reservations for campsites, cabins, day-use areas, boat ramps, hiking permits, and the America the Beautiful Interagency Pass. The site serves facilities across national forests, national parks, wildlife refuges, and Corps of Engineers lakes.

## Getting Started

- [Recreation.gov - Camping, Cabins, RVs, Permits, Passes & More](https://www.recreation.gov): Homepage for booking camping, permits & passes at 3,600+ US facilities
- [About Us - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/about-us): About Recreation.gov and federal agency partners managing public lands

## Day-Use and Entrance Passes

- [White House Day Use Pass - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/202186): Day use permit for White House trailhead near Paria Canyon/The Wave
- [Roan Mountain Pass in North Carolina - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/61fbc55a-541e-11eb-a0f2-961d2dbb3a8a): Entrance pass for Roan Mountain rhododendron gardens, North Carolina
- [Willis Creek Day Use Passes Pass in Texas - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/04f0a13e-7acf-11eb-9b8e-72edbbd009f6): Day use pass for Willis Creek Park at Granger Lake, Texas
- [Boise National Forest Day Use Pass Pass in Idaho - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/05569472-46fe-11ec-bc25-8ae5dfd82350): Annual day use pass for Boise National Forest, Idaho (2.5M acres)
- [Catwalk Recreation Area Pass in New Mexico - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/29364832-c4a0-11eb-9610-ca5a163054ad): Day use pass for Catwalk trail in Gila National Forest, New Mexico
- [Jennings Ferry Park Day Use Passes Pass in Alabama - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/2a1fefd3-f699-11ea-a1ae-aee12105d3ef): Day/annual pass for Jennings Ferry Park on Black Warrior River, Alabama
- [Coffee Mill Day Use Pass Pass in Texas - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/3aa7de1d-50b4-11ec-b4fc-e2991eccb773): Day use pass for Coffee Mill Lake Recreation Area, Texas NF
- [Guffey Gorge / Paradise Cove Pass in Colorado - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/261716): Day pass for Guffey Gorge waterfall hike at Royal Gorge, Colorado

## Boating and Water Access

- [Crab Orchard National Wildlife Refuge Vessel Pass Pass in Illinois - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/0efb8f4d-fb92-11eb-b561-72dd549c1fc9): Vessel pass for Crab Orchard National Wildlife Refuge, Illinois
- [Shasta-Trinity National Forest - Clark Springs Boat Ramp Pass in California - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/48f78b4a-2ba0-11ec-b358-6a51c3373d5c): Boat ramp pass for Clark Springs at Trinity Lake, California
- [Wildwood Boat Ramp Pass in Oklahoma - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/67c4380e-8d4d-11ec-aa0b-8263980a6523): Boat ramp day pass for Wildwood at Fort Gibson Lake, Oklahoma

## Shooting Ranges

- [Enoree Rifle Ranges Pass in South Carolina - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/1dc066be-9cd6-11eb-abf8-fafcea60a80f): Shooting range pass for Enoree District, Francis Marion/Sumter NF
- [Sumac Creek Shooting Range Pass in Georgia - Recreation.gov](https://www.recreation.gov/activitypass/43f96dca-77bd-11eb-86df-e60b5d20d0e4): Daily/annual pass for Sumac Creek Shooting Range, Chattahoochee-Oconee NF
